purpose: Machine-readable full-bank semantic review and author review for the Patternly-owned CCAR-P practice profile. This is not an official Anthropic exam blueprint.

sourceChecks.finding: Official guidance supports deferred tool discovery when a large catalog creates context/tool-selection cost; it explicitly says this adds a discovery latency step and is less beneficial for small, compact, frequently used catalogs. Used to validate both sides of D03-O01 selection cases.

Official agent engineering article supports parallelizing independent subtasks, maintaining dependencies, and evaluating full outcome/cost; no blanket recommendation to parallelize dependent work. Used for D03-O03 cases.

Current Claude docs recommend workload-specific evaluation balancing capability, speed and cost; efficiency-first and capability-first are both valid depending on workload. Supports decision scenarios with explicit quality and latency floors.

Current API streaming docs specify message_start/content block/message_delta/message_stop events and distinguish incremental deltas from accumulated complete messages; supports stream completion and client delivery items.
Current rate-limit docs describe retry-after and limits; retry behavior must distinguish throttling from spend-limit and other failures. Supports bounded throttling scenarios.

Official MCP specification confirms authorization is optional generally, SHOULD for HTTP when supported, SHOULD NOT be followed for stdio, whose credentials come from environment; protected HTTP authorization binds tokens to intended resources and validates them. App-specific protections remain scenario premises.

Official article describes orchestrator/worker parallel research and stresses evaluation, coordination, operational reliability and token cost; does not prescribe universal content logging. Supports using event/evidence links and bounded operational telemetry as original application design.

Current official Claude Code CLI docs confirm interactive sessions, piped/non-interactive `-p` use, and local working-directory continuation. Supports choosing CLI for repository/terminal workflows; exact network/server policy remains supplied by scenarios.

Official MCP base specification describes optional server features and separates the protocol from application data-plane contracts. It supports the notion that MCP need not replace existing typed/bulk APIs; that architecture choice remains scenario-specific.

Pinned MCP specification confirms `tools.listChanged` signals tool-list changes and servers SHOULD send `notifications/tools/list_changed`; `tools/list` refreshes the list. Supports exact claim in D03-O07-depth-62.
Pinned MCP specification states servers MUST validate resource URIs and SHOULD implement access control for sensitive resources. Supports exact claim in D03-O07-depth-63.

Pinned MCP resources spec defines optional resource subscriptions and `notifications/resources/updated` for subscribed resource content changes, distinct from list membership notifications. Supports D03-O07-depth-74.
